title: Self-hosted Kata/Cloud Hypervisor execution adapter validation
title_es: Validación del adaptador de ejecución Kata/Cloud Hypervisor en servidores propios
runtime: Kata Containers with Cloud Hypervisor, invoked through Docker/containerd
infrastructure_costs: Operator supplies and maintains compute, storage and backups.

kvm.reason: MicroVM execution requires usable /dev/kvm; host/container fallback is disabled

tests.suite: Focused microVM policy and startup protocol recheck
tests.note: Subset of isolation discovery. Does not boot VMs.

tests.failure: Chromium did not create DevToolsActivePort within the test startup deadline. Rust compilation was concurrent; causation was not established.

tests.note: Added startup diagnostics; production browser policy and timeout were not weakened. This retry does not demonstrate stability under load.

tests.ignored_reason: Opt-in live Python language server test requires FENIX_TEST_PYLSP.

tests.reason: No usable /dev/kvm and no installed runtime bundle.

workspace_image.package_dependency_simulation: passed with apt-get update and apt-get -s install in a disposable container
workspace_image.initial_issue_fixed: Removed unavailable Debian python3-pptx package; LibreOffice Impress remains included.
workspace_image.reason: About 1.1 GiB free on development filesystem; full Office/multimedia build deferred.

covered_behaviors: Fail closed when KVM is missing, runtime is unknown, configuration is unsafe or pinned assets change.
Startup gate blocks user code until host verification and current account authorization.
Exact account cgroup matching is tested with synthetic process metadata.
Persistent private tool homes survive real OCI runner replacement; LSP cannot modify saved tool homes.
VM overhead is reserved in admission; monthly execution duration is reserved, settled and recovered conservatively after restart.
Existing OCI terminal, private tunnel, revocation and descendant cleanup scenarios still pass.
unverified_or_not_implemented: Real VM boot and compatibility with the exact installed Kata/Cloud Hypervisor release.
Actual guest seccomp, virtio-fs read-only behavior, PTY and Chromium inside Kata.
Actual VM and virtiofsd cgroup accounting, cleanup and multi-account resource pressure.
Complete workspace image build and document application acceptance inside a VM.
RAM snapshots, suspended process restoration, live migration, warm pools and replicated storage.
Windows desktop, GPU support and general unrestricted guest root administration.
operator_next_step: Prepare a dedicated KVM host, install verified upstream runtime assets, build the workspace image, configure real account capacity and run the opt-in VM acceptance suite before customer traffic.
resumen_es: Código implementado sin suscripción externa. Pasaron las pruebas de política, 100 pruebas Rust y los casos OCI tras repetir un fallo de arranque del navegador. No se activó en producción ni se arrancaron VM: falta KVM. La imagen completa de documentos y la validación en hardware siguen pendientes.
